test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 13 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: p + q = 12 and p ² - q ² = 72 then then what is the value of p-q?
solution:
**Given:**

p + q = 12

p² − q² = 72

**Formula Used:**

a² − b² = (a − b) × (a + b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ p² − q² = (p − q) × (p + q)

⇒ (p − q) × (p + q) = 72

⇒ (p − q) × 12 = 72

⇒ p − q = 72 ÷ 12

⇒ p − q = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**
